title: Run Data Integrity and Recovery Testing
summary: Isolated integrity checks: 23 PASS, 2 NOT_RUN, 1 NOT_IN_SCOPE. Production WAL/logical-export restore was not attempted in this workstation (no POSTGRES_URL). Founder has not accepted. Row not marked Complete.

tests.name: Atomic registration save
tests.expected: User, required consents, and verification token persist and re-read from a new store instance

tests.name: Journey progress save
tests.expected: Progress upsert is durable on re-read

tests.name: Analytics event save
tests.expected: Controlled events persist and re-read by idempotency key

tests.name: Save redacts prohibited fields
tests.expected: Password/token fields are not stored on the analytics event

tests.name: Lumina memory save
tests.expected: Enabled memory write is retrievable for the same user

tests.name: KPI purchase save
tests.expected: Isolated KPI ledger records the sandbox purchase once

tests.name: Launch-critical stores select durable Postgres in production
tests.expected: Lumina, Journey progress, and billing projection select supabase_postgres when configured and fail closed on hosted production

tests.name: Analytics duplicate idempotency
tests.expected: Second write with the same idempotency key is duplicate; one stored row

tests.name: KPI purchase duplicate session
tests.expected: Same Stripe checkout session does not create a second purchase row or second revenue event

tests.name: Duplicate email registration rejected
tests.expected: Second persistEmailRegistration for the same email throws DUPLICATE_EMAIL

tests.name: File-store backup snapshot
tests.expected: Backup file is written and restore returns consent count to the pre-mutation snapshot

tests.name: File-store restore
tests.expected: Restored analytics and KPI files still contain the saved purchase identifiers

tests.name: Isolated pglite restore
tests.expected: Known dump restores analytics=2, purchases=1, all critical tables, dump removed; destination is not production
tests.actual: ok=true; tables=23; analytics=2; purchases=1; dumpRemoved=true; missing=none; error=none

tests.name: Production Postgres isolated restore
tests.expected: Logical export restored into isolated pglite without modifying production

tests.name: Production WAL / platform backup probe
tests.expected: Production archive_mode and isolated restore can be re-verified when POSTGRES_URL is present

tests.name: Verification token deletion retains account and consents
tests.expected: Deleting a verification token does not delete the user or consent history

tests.name: Lumina memory clear retains identity and consent history
tests.expected: Clear removes durable summaries, does not wipe the account, and keeps consent records

tests.name: Targeted test-event deletion
tests.expected: deleteTestEventsByKeys removes only the named test events

tests.name: Account erasure is out of launch scope
tests.expected: Launch participant copy states account deletion is not available yet. Row 181 tests deletion of tokens, Lumina memory, and targeted events — not GDPR erasure.
tests.actual: deleteUser=false; deleteAccount=false; citations=content/i18n/dictionaries/en.ts account deletion which is not available yet

tests.name: Consent history is append-only
tests.expected: Recording the same consent type again appends a new history row instead of replacing

tests.name: Required registration consents retained
tests.expected: terms, privacy, participant agreement, and AI disclosure remain in history

tests.name: No consent mutation APIs on AuthStore
tests.expected: AuthStore cannot delete or overwrite consent history

tests.name: Support cannot mutate consent history
tests.expected: Support mutation helper is forbidden-by-design and does not write consent history

tests.name: User identity reconciles across stores
tests.expected: Auth, consents, journey, and analytics all key to the same user id with no orphan consents

tests.name: Purchase identifiers reconcile analytics ↔ KPI
tests.expected: Same sandbox checkout session and amount in analytics purchase_completed and KPI purchase

tests.name: Consent records reconcile to published document versions
tests.expected: Persisted registration consents keep the document id and version from the legal catalog

remainingRisks: This workstation has no POSTGRES_URL, so production Supabase WAL/PITR listing and a live logical export were not re-run. Isolated pglite restore of a known dump was executed instead. Prior Row 62 evidence (2026-08-21) recorded a production isolated restore PASS.

Production WAL/PITR dashboard proof and a live logical export from Production remain Founder-held unless the CRON_SECRET-gated /api/fab-5/aos/backup-probe is invoked on Vercel Production. This workstation has no POSTGRES_URL.
Stripe remains the payment system of record. Postgres billing tables are a webhook/entitlement projection; restoring them is not a Stripe ledger restore.
Account erasure is OUT OF LAUNCH SCOPE (participant copy: account deletion is not available yet). Deletion tests cover tokens, Lumina memory clear, and targeted events only.
